description.value: Sapperton District Taphouse is a craft gastropub in New Westminster's historic Sapperton neighbourhood, pouring from 33 rotating taps of local BC craft beer alongside elevated pub fare and handcrafted cocktails. The two-storey space blends exposed brick and warm cedar accents with cozy booths, a custom craft room, and a 100-inch projector plus 13 smart TVs for sports viewing. Weekly poker nights and Saturday DJ nights make it a lively community anchor in the heart of Sapperton.

address.value: 421 E Columbia St, New Westminster, BC V3L 3X3
